evidence.outcome: Passed; Vite production build completed with existing SignalR Rollup annotation warnings.
GET /api/auth/me returns csrfToken, uid, name, and role.
Owner-only navigation metadata is filtered by me.role; post-login finishSignIn hydrates /api/auth/me; direct non-owner users/audit tabs render Forbidden.
Role change, password reset, and delete confirmations are present; owner row controls are hidden; audit pagination uses beforeId and limit=50 with outcome colors.
api() adds X-CSRF-Token to unsafe requests; account password/token inputs are masked and secret values are not rendered.
Backend owner authorization and denial auditing remain active, including owner self-protection through endpoint/account checks.

next_slice.summary: Milestone 1 RBAC/audit QA is complete. Optional polish: confirm account creation, handle delete errors consistently, and style success messages separately from errors. No further security blocker identified.

result: Final RBAC/UI QA passes backend tests and frontend build. /api/auth/me now returns csrfToken, uid, name, and role; post-login hydration reads this payload; owner-only navigation is filtered and direct non-owner users/audit tabs show a Forbidden state. Account role-change, password-reset, and delete actions have confirmations; owner controls are hidden and backend owner/self-protection remains enforced. Audit UI supports newest-first beforeId pagination and outcome styling. Mutating UI calls add CSRF headers and no passwords, hashes, tokens, or CSRF values are displayed. Minor residuals: account creation has no confirmation prompt, direct delete lacks a catch/error display, and the password-change success message is rendered using the generic error styling.
